end.summary:
Anika practised sorting objects that roll, slide or stack.
They predicted that curved surfaces roll in 9 of 11 attempts without help.
They named balls, drums, laddoos, glasses and oranges as objects that can roll.
The belief that only balls can roll appeared once and was not clearly corrected after it was last seen.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Anika practised noticing curved and flat surfaces to predict whether objects will roll. They used examples such as a drum, laddoo, glass and orange, and explained some choices using shape. The mix-up that only balls can roll was not clearly corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask them to test safe household objects and explain which surface helps each one roll, slide or stack.
